name: io.github.NJ-Burrito/business-wrap
title: Business-Wrap
description: Build the bilingual requirements-document editor, apply edits files, export PDF + DOCX and design packs. Local only: run node mcp/cli.mjs from a clone or the installed plugin (no npm package).

launch.cwd: A clone of the repository (git clone https://github.com/NJ-Burrito/Business-Wrap), or the Claude Code plugin folder, where the plugin runs node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/mcp/cli.mjs.
launch.requires: Node.js 20 or newer; npm install in the clone for playwright-core.

environmentVariables.name: BW_FONT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder holding the TrueType font cuts (searched recursively).

environmentVariables.name: BW_CHROME
environmentVariables.description: Chrome or Edge executable used to print the PDF.
